The current arcade also provides the foundation for the Restaurant Arena: a human-facing multi-agent game whose state, actions, and consented interaction traces can later feed a separate frozen evaluation environment.\n\n## Play\n\nBuild the overlay once, then launch the arcade menu or a specific game:\n\n```bash\nbun install\nbun run build:overlay   # web bundle + native Tauri shell (needs Rust)\nbun start               # overlay menu\nbun start restaurant-arena  # jump straight into Restaurant Arena\n# or after `bun run build`: gamepigeon / gamepigeon restaurant-arena\n```\n\nIn the overlay: arrow keys or WASD to move, `Enter` to select, `r` to restart, `Esc` or `q` to hide. Drag the top bar to move the window; use the expand control to resize it.\n\n### Session save\n\nEvery launch keeps exactly one `SavedGame` record in `localStorage` under\n`gamepigeon.arcade.active-game.v1` (`overlay/persistence.ts`): `gameId`,\n`gameVersion`, `variationId`, the run's `seed`, and the ordered `actions`\ntaken so far, so the same run can be rebuilt action-by-action on the next\nlaunch. The two ways a run stops mid-shift treat that record differently:\n\n- **Ending a shift back to the menu** (the in-canvas \"menu\" control, or a\n  host `gamepigeon:reset`) leaves the save exactly as it was. The seed and\n  the action log are untouched, so resuming later replays the identical run.\n- **Restarting mid-run** (`r`, or the in-canvas \"restart\" control) throws the\n  save away and opens a brand-new run of the same game and variation: a\n  freshly randomized `seed` -- never the seed of the run it replaces -- and\n  an empty action log. Restart means \"start over with a new run,\" not\n  \"replay the same seed again\"; only a resumed/recovered launch reuses a\n  stored seed.\n\n### Window sizes\n\nThe native Tauri frame — and the browser preview, which mirrors it pixel for pixel — uses these exact logical sizes:\n\n| State | Trigger | Width × height |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| Compact (default) | boot, or the expand control while expanded | 600 × 850 |\n| Expanded | the expand control while compact | 830 × 900 |\n| Minimized pill | Hide (`Esc` / `q` / the hide button) | 144 × 48 |\n| Restored floor | clicking the pill again | back to the compact size, never smaller than 500 × 700 |\n\nThese are exactly the values `overlay/tauri-bridge.ts` exports as `COMPACT_SIZE`, `EXPANDED_SIZE`, `PILL_SIZE`, and `MIN_SIZE`, and what `overlay/preview.html` frames the browser preview at.\n\n## Install: local vs. global\n\nThere are two ways to run the Tui overlay. **Local** runs it straight from this\ncheckout for development. **Global** installs it once so the plain `claude` command\nopens Tui in every project.\n\nLocal development needs [Bun](https://bun.sh) (`>=1.3`), macOS 11+, Windows 10+, Ubuntu 22.04+,\nor a current Fedora release, and Rust only when building the overlay binary from source.\nPublished npm and harness installs bootstrap Bun on first launch when it is missing.\n\n### Local (from this checkout)\n\nBuild the overlay and wire the harness adapters to this working copy:\n\n```bash\nbun install\nbun run build:overlay      # overlay web bundle + native Tauri shell (needs Rust)\nbun run install:adapters   # installs Codex / Claude / OpenCode adapters -> this checkout\n```\n\nRestart your harness. The generated adapters live at `~/.codex/skills/arcade`,\n`~/.claude/skills/arcade`, and `~/.config/opencode/commands/arcade.md`; all execute\n`scripts/overlay.ts` from this checkout.\n\nFor local harness development, one command builds the current checkout, replaces any\nstale overlay, and points at the debug Tauri binary instead of the packaged release:\n\n```bash\nbun run claude:dev        # Claude Code — loads this checkout via --plugin-dir .\nbun run codex:dev         # Codex — workspace plugin + $arcade adapter from this checkout\nbun run antigravity:dev   # Antigravity — .agents/plugins/ workspace plugin + agy\n```\n\nClaude appears as `/tui-gamepigeon:arcade`. Codex uses the `$arcade` skill (or `/arcade` picker).\nAntigravity picks up `.agents/plugins/tui-gamepigeon/` from the repo root. All three set\n`GAMEPIGEON_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK=1` so local dev is not fighting the release auto-updater.\n\nTo open the overlay directly without a harness:\n\n```bash\nbun run start            # menu\nbun run start restaurant-arena # a specific game\nbun run preview:overlay  # browser preview at 600×850 (no Tauri)\nbun run dev:overlay      # rebuild web bundle + debug shell, then show\n```\n\n#### Browser preview\n\nAgents (and humans) can iterate on overlay layout without a Rust build:\n\n```bash\nbun run preview:overlay\n# → http://127.0.0.1:4173/ (opens your browser)\nbun run preview:overlay -- --game=restaurant-arena\n```\n\nThe preview frames the real overlay UI at the production sizes (**600×850** compact, **830×900** expanded — see [Window sizes](#window-sizes)). Titlebar **↗ / ↙** toggles the frame and Hide collapses it to the pill, both firing the same `gamepigeon:preview-resize` events the native app would (see [Window sizes](#window-sizes)); Shutdown is still a no-op in the browser since there is no native process to end. Open a game from the menu, or pass `--game=<id>` / use `?game=<id>` (optional `&variation=classic`).\n\n### Global (installed once, works everywhere)\n\nFor Codex (or another supported harness), the one-command install is:\n\n```bash\nnpx -y bun x @tui-games/tui@latest install --codex\n```\n\nReplace `--codex` with `--claude`, `--opencode`, `--hermes`, `--openclaw`, or\n`--antigravity`, or `--all`. For Antigravity, run it from the project directory;\nit writes that project's `.agents/plugins/tui-gamepigeon` plugin. This uses npm to\nfetch Bun for the command, then writes the harness adapter.\nRestart the harness when it finishes.\n\nInstall the plugin from the GitHub marketplace so the normal `claude` command runs\nthe lifecycle hooks in every project:\n\n```bash\nclaude plugin marketplace add Trolleroof/tui-gamepigeon\nclaude plugin install tui-gamepigeon@tui-gamepigeon --scope user\n```\n\nOptionally enable Claude's marketplace refresh under `/plugin` → **Marketplaces** →\n**tui-gamepigeon**, and point the status line at the Tui update shim once:\n\n```json\n\"statusLine\": {\n  \"type\": \"command\",\n  \"command\": \"bun ~/.gamepigeon/status-line.ts\"\n}\n```\n\nThe packaged plugin exposes `/tui-gamepigeon:arcade` and `/tui-gamepigeon:arcade-update`;\nthe standalone adapter provides Claude's shorter `/arcade`.\n\n## Optional account\n\nTui requires an account. On first launch the plugin opens the shared web login, where a new player can create an account or sign in with email, Google, or GitHub. Later launches reuse the private local session.\n\n```bash\ngamepigeon auth signup\ngamepigeon auth login\ngamepigeon auth oauth google\ngamepigeon auth oauth github\ngamepigeon auth status\ngamepigeon auth logout\n```\n\nProduction defaults to `https://runretroarcade.com/login.html`, `https://auth.runretroarcade.com`, and `https://api.runretroarcade.com`. Override them for local development with `GAMEPIGEON_LOGIN_URL`, `GAMEPIGEON_AUTH_URL`, and `GAMEPIGEON_BACKEND_URL`. The browser returns the Better Auth bearer to a localhost callback; it is stored in `auth.json` and atomically mirrored to `backend.conf`, both with user-only permissions. That same bearer authenticates `/v1/me`, trace uploads, and completed-game results. If that validation or an upload fails, Tui marks the account chip **Sync paused** while keeping gameplay data queued locally. Logout clears both credentials without deleting local games or traces.\n\n## Coding harness adapters\n\nThe bundled adapters give Codex CLI, Claude Code, and OpenCode the same Tui launcher. Tui opens a centered, borderless HTML overlay above the active desktop. It uses the operating system's installed webview through a small Tauri shell, not Chrome or Electron.\n\nRequirements:\n\n- Bun\n- macOS 11+, Windows 10+, Ubuntu 22.04+, or a current Fedora release\n- A packaged overlay binary, or Rust when building it from source\n\nThe overlay is a single-instance helper with no Dock icon on macOS and no taskbar or console entry on Windows or Linux. Hiding it keeps the game state alive; invoking Tui again restores and centers the existing window. It works from regular terminals and does not require tmux, a browser, a local server, or an extra setup command after plugin installation.\n\nLinux uses the system WebKitGTK runtime. Install the build dependencies before building from source:\n\n```bash\n# Ubuntu\nsudo apt update\nsudo apt install libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libxdo-dev libssl-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev\n\n# Fedora\nsudo dnf install webkit2gtk4.1-devel openssl-devel libappindicator-gtk3-devel librsvg2-devel libxdo-devel\nsudo dnf group install c-development\n```\n\nInstall the dependencies and all three harness adapters from this checkout:\n\n```bash\nbun install\nbun run build:overlay\nbun run install:adapters\n```\n\nRestart the harness after installation. The browser returns the Better Auth bearer to a localhost callback; it is stored in `auth.json` and atomically mirrored to `backend.conf`, both with user-only permissions. A timer here would start while the request is still in line and\n    // abort a crew that is only waiting its turn.\n    timeoutMs: null,\n    complete: async (request: ModelRequest, signal: AbortSignal) => {\n      const role = request.observation.role;\n      const startedAt = performance.now();\n      setWorkerStatus(role, \"thinking\");\n      // A request already queued behind the account's share is not pending on\n      // the model; the budget banner is the more specific thing to say. The\n      // activity feed still logs the request either way -- it is a log of what\n      // happened, not a description of the current state.\n      if (shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) setWorkerMode(`Pending · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${role}`, \"pending\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${role}: requested live action`);\n      const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();\n      const cancel = () => void invoke(\"cancel_worker_model\", { requestId });\n      signal.addEventListener(\"abort\", cancel, { once: true });\n      try {\n        const response = await invoke<WorkerModelResponse>(\"complete_worker_model\", {\n          requestId,\n          request: { systemPrompt: request.systemPrompt, turnPrompt: request.turnPrompt },\n        });\n        if (signal.aborted) throw new Error(\"model request canceled\");\n        setWorkerStatus(role, \"acting\");\n        addWorkerActivity(`${role}: response received in ${Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt)}ms`);\n        return { text: response.text, metrics: workerModelMetrics(response) };\n      } finally {\n        signal.removeEventListener(\"abort\", cancel);\n      }\n    },\n  });\n  let orchestrator: WorkerOrchestrator;\n  orchestrator = new WorkerOrchestrator(arena, {\n    client,\n    model: workerModel,\n    tickIntervalMs: () => arena.tickMs() || 1_000,\n    onError: (turn) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator) return;\n      setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: fallback — ${turn.error ?? \"invalid action\"}`);\n      // A shift held back by the shared account is waiting, not broken (#281).\n      // Only the banner is suppressed; the feed above still records the turn.\n      if (!shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) return;\n      setWorkerMode(`Fallback · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${turn.role}: ${turn.error ?? \"invalid action\"}`, \"error\");\n    },\n    onTick: (report: OrchestratorTick) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator || game !== activeGame) return;\n      for (const turn of report.turns) {\n        if (turn.status === \"accepted\") {\n          setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"acting\");\n          addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: applied ${turn.action?.tool ?? \"action\"}`);\n        }\n        else if (turn.status === \"fallback\" || turn.status === \"rejected\") setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      }\n      // Turns landing again is proof the account is answering, whatever the\n      // last throttle said was left on its countdown.\n      if (report.turns.every((turn) => turn.status === \"accepted\")) setWorkerBudget(WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR);\n      drawGame();\n    },\n  });\n  workerOrchestrator = orchestrator;\n}\n\n/** Every control funnels through here — the panel's only write path. */\nfunction submitIntervention(input: PlayerInterventionInput): void {\n  if (!game) return;\n  const withIntervene = game as PlayableGame & {\n    submitPlayerIntervention?: (i: PlayerInterventionInput) => { accepted: boolean; error?: { message: string } };\n  };\n  if (!withIntervene.submitPlayerIntervention) return;\n  workerOrchestrator?.pause();\n  const result = withIntervene.submitPlayerIntervention(input);\n  if (result.accepted) {\n    setInterveneStatus(\"Sent.\");\n  } else {\n    setInterveneStatus(result.error?.message ?? The\n      // activity feed still logs the request either way -- it is a log of what\n      // happened, not a description of the current state.\n      if (shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) setWorkerMode(`Pending · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${role}`, \"pending\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${role}: requested live action`);\n      const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();\n      const cancel = () => void invoke(\"cancel_worker_model\", { requestId });\n      signal.addEventListener(\"abort\", cancel, { once: true });\n      try {\n        const response = await invoke<WorkerModelResponse>(\"complete_worker_model\", {\n          requestId,\n          request: { systemPrompt: request.systemPrompt, turnPrompt: request.turnPrompt },\n        });\n        if (signal.aborted) throw new Error(\"model request canceled\");\n        setWorkerStatus(role, \"acting\");\n        addWorkerActivity(`${role}: response received in ${Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt)}ms`);\n        return { text: response.text, metrics: workerModelMetrics(response) };\n      } finally {\n        signal.removeEventListener(\"abort\", cancel);\n      }\n    },\n  });\n  let orchestrator: WorkerOrchestrator;\n  orchestrator = new WorkerOrchestrator(arena, {\n    client,\n    model: workerModel,\n    tickIntervalMs: () => arena.tickMs() || 1_000,\n    onError: (turn) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator) return;\n      setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: fallback — ${turn.error ?? \"invalid action\"}`);\n      // A shift held back by the shared account is waiting, not broken (#281).\n      // Only the banner is suppressed; the feed above still records the turn.\n      if (!shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) return;\n      setWorkerMode(`Fallback · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${turn.role}: ${turn.error ?? \"invalid action\"}`, \"error\");\n    },\n    onTick: (report: OrchestratorTick) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator || game !== activeGame) return;\n      for (const turn of report.turns) {\n        if (turn.status === \"accepted\") {\n          setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"acting\");\n          addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: applied ${turn.action?.tool ?? \"action\"}`);\n        }\n        else if (turn.status === \"fallback\" || turn.status === \"rejected\") setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      }\n      // Turns landing again is proof the account is answering, whatever the\n      // last throttle said was left on its countdown.\n      if (report.turns.every((turn) => turn.status === \"accepted\")) setWorkerBudget(WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR);\n      drawGame();\n    },\n  });\n  workerOrchestrator = orchestrator;\n}\n\n/** Every control funnels through here — the panel's only write path. */\nfunction submitIntervention(input: PlayerInterventionInput): void {\n  if (!game) return;\n  const withIntervene = game as PlayableGame & {\n    submitPlayerIntervention?: (i: PlayerInterventionInput) => { accepted: boolean; error?: { message: string } };\n  };\n  if (!withIntervene.submitPlayerIntervention) return;\n  workerOrchestrator?.pause();\n  const result = withIntervene.submitPlayerIntervention(input);\n  if (result.accepted) {\n    setInterveneStatus(\"Sent.\");\n  } else {\n    setInterveneStatus(result.error?.message ?? \"Could not send that.\", \"error\");\n  }\n  // A rejected stale/invalid intervention must not strand live workers in the\n  // paused state either; drawGame() re-enters the selected scheduler.\n  drawGame();\n}\n\n/** Wire the static shell once per mount; content refreshes in place after. */\nfunction bindInterventionPanel(): void {\n  const els = interveneEls();\n  if (!els.toggle || !els.panel) return;\n  interveneRole = \"chef\";\n\n  els.toggle.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    const opening = els.panel!.hidden;\n    els.panel!.hidden = !opening;\n    els.toggle!.setAttribute(\"aria-expanded\", String(opening));\n    if (opening && game) refreshInterventionPanel(game);\n  });\n  els.close?.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    els.panel!.hidden = true;\n    els.toggle!.setAttribute(\"aria-expanded\", \"false\");\n  });\n  els.roles?.addEventListener(\"click\", (event) => {\n    const target = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLButtonElement>(\"[data-role]\");\n    if (!target?.dataset.role) return;\n    interveneRole = target.dataset.role as PlayerInterventionInput[\"targetRole\"];\n    els.roles!.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>(\"[data-role]\").forEach((btn) => btn.classList.toggle(\"is-selected\", btn === target));\n  });\n  els.send?.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    const text = els.text?.value.trim() ?? ` · ${workerModel.version}` : \"\"}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * What the shared model account is doing to this shift, and the timer that\n * takes the banner down if the transport goes quiet. A throttle gets no\n * follow-up report -- the next request simply happens later -- so the\n * countdown is what clears it.\n */\nlet workerBudget: WorkerBudgetState = WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR;\nlet workerBudgetTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;\n\nfunction setWorkerBudget(state: WorkerBudgetState): void {\n  workerBudget = state;\n  if (workerBudgetTimer !== undefined) clearTimeout(workerBudgetTimer);\n  workerBudgetTimer = undefined;\n  const message = workerBudgetMessage(state, workerModelLabel());\n  if (!message) {\n    setWorkerMode();\n    return;\n  }\n  setWorkerMode(message, \"waiting\");\n  workerBudgetTimer = setTimeout(() => setWorkerBudget(WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR), workerBudgetHoldMs(state));\n}\n\nfunction setWorkerMode(message = workerModelLabel(), tone: \"live\" | \"pending\" | \"waiting\" | \"error\" | undefined = workerModel ? \"live\" : undefined): void {\n  const status = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(\"[data-arena-worker-mode]\");\n  if (!status) return;\n  status.textContent = message;\n  if (tone) status.dataset.tone = tone;\n  else delete status.dataset.tone;\n}\n\nfunction setWorkerStatus(role: Role | \"expediter\", status: \"idle\" | \"thinking\" | \"acting\" | \"error\"): void {\n  restaurantArenaScene?.setWorkerStatus(role, status);\n}\n\nfunction addWorkerActivity(message: string): void {\n  workerActivity.unshift(message);\n  workerActivity.splice(8);\n  const feed = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLOListElement>(\"[data-arena-worker-activity]\");\n  if (!feed) return;\n  feed.replaceChildren(...workerActivity.map((entry) => {\n    const item = document.createElement(\"li\");\n    item.textContent = entry;\n    return item;\n  }));\n}\n\nfunction stopWorkerOrchestrator(): void {\n  workerOrchestrator?.stop();\n  workerOrchestrator = undefined;\n  // Leaving the shift ends the wait it described; a banner counting down over\n  // the menu would be describing requests nobody is making.\n  if (workerBudgetTimer !== undefined) clearTimeout(workerBudgetTimer);\n  workerBudgetTimer = undefined;\n  workerBudget = WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR;\n}\n\ninterface WorkerModelResponse {\n  text: string;\n  queueMs: number;\n  providerMs: number;\n  inputTokens?: number;\n  outputTokens?: number;\n  cachedInputTokens?: number;\n  finishReason?: string;\n}\n\n/** Absent provider fields (no usage on this response) stay absent, not zero. */\nfunction workerModelMetrics(response: WorkerModelResponse): ModelCallMetrics {\n  return {\n    queueMs: response.queueMs,\n    providerMs: response.providerMs,\n    ...(response.inputTokens !== undefined ? { inputTokens: response.inputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.outputTokens !== undefined ? { outputTokens: response.outputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.cachedInputTokens !== undefined ? { cachedInputTokens: response.cachedInputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.finishReason !== undefined ? { finishReason: response.finishReason } : {}),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction attachWorkerOrchestrator(activeGame: PlayableGame): void {\n  if (!workerModel || activeGame.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return;\n  workerActivity.length = 0;\n  const arena = activeGame as unknown as RestaurantGame;\n  const client = new WorkerModelClient({\n    retries: 0,\n    // The Rust transport bounds the provider call and starts that bound after\n    // the request budget admits it, so queue time is not charged to the\n    // worker. A timer here would start while the request is still in line and\n    // abort a crew that is only waiting its turn.\n    timeoutMs: null,\n    complete: async (request: ModelRequest, signal: AbortSignal) => {\n      const role = request.observation.role;\n      const startedAt = performance.now();\n      setWorkerStatus(role, \"thinking\");\n      // A request already queued behind the account's share is not pending on\n      // the model; the budget banner is the more specific thing to say. The\n      // activity feed still logs the request either way -- it is a log of what\n      // happened, not a description of the current state.\n      if (shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) setWorkerMode(`Pending · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${role}`, \"pending\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${role}: requested live action`);\n      const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();\n      const cancel = () => void invoke(\"cancel_worker_model\", { requestId });\n      signal.addEventListener(\"abort\", cancel, { once: true });\n      try {\n        const response = await invoke<WorkerModelResponse>(\"complete_worker_model\", {\n          requestId,\n          request: { systemPrompt: request.systemPrompt, turnPrompt: request.turnPrompt },\n        });\n        if (signal.aborted) throw new Error(\"model request canceled\");\n        setWorkerStatus(role, \"acting\");\n        addWorkerActivity(`${role}: response received in ${Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt)}ms`);\n        return { text: response.text, metrics: workerModelMetrics(response) };\n      } finally {\n        signal.removeEventListener(\"abort\", cancel);\n      }\n    },\n  });\n  let orchestrator: WorkerOrchestrator;\n  orchestrator = new WorkerOrchestrator(arena, {\n    client,\n    model: workerModel,\n    tickIntervalMs: () => arena.tickMs() || 1_000,\n    onError: (turn) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator) return;\n      setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: fallback — ${turn.error ?? \"invalid action\"}`);\n      // A shift held back by the shared account is waiting, not broken (#281).\n      // Only the banner is suppressed; the feed above still records the turn.\n      if (!shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) return;\n      setWorkerMode(`Fallback · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${turn.role}: ${turn.error ?? \"invalid action\"}`, \"error\");\n    },\n    onTick: (report: OrchestratorTick) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator || game !== activeGame) return;\n      for (const turn of report.turns) {\n        if (turn.status === \"accepted\") {\n          setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"acting\");\n          addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: applied ${turn.action?.tool ?? \"action\"}`);\n        }\n        else if (turn.status === \"fallback\" || turn.status === \"rejected\") setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      }\n      // Turns landing again is proof the account is answering, whatever the\n      // last throttle said was left on its countdown.\n      if (report.turns.every((turn) => turn.status === \"accepted\")) setWorkerBudget(WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR);\n      drawGame();\n    },\n  });\n  workerOrchestrator = orchestrator;\n}\n\n/** Every control funnels through here — the panel's only write path. */\nfunction submitIntervention(input: PlayerInterventionInput): void {\n  if (!game) return;\n  const withIntervene = game as PlayableGame & {\n    submitPlayerIntervention?: (i: PlayerInterventionInput) => { accepted: boolean; error?: { message: string } };\n  };\n  if (!withIntervene.submitPlayerIntervention) return;\n  workerOrchestrator?.pause();\n  const result = withIntervene.submitPlayerIntervention(input);\n  if (result.accepted) {\n    setInterveneStatus(\"Sent.\");\n  } else {\n    setInterveneStatus(result.error?.message ?? \"\";\n    if (!text) {\n      setInterveneStatus(\"Say something first.\", \"error\");\n      return;\n    }\n    submitIntervention({ kind: \"message\", targetRole: interveneRole, text, priority: els.urgent?.checked ? \"high\" : \"normal\" });\n    if (els.text) els.text.value = \"\";\n    if (els.urgent) els.urgent.checked = false;\n  });\n  els.correct?.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    submitIntervention({ kind: \"correction\", targetRole: interveneRole });\n  });\n  // Passing is a decision, so it goes on the record like any other. Doing\n  // nothing and choosing to do nothing read identically in a trace otherwise.\n  els.pass?.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    if (!game) return;\n    const withPass = game as PlayableGame & { passRound?: () => { accepted: boolean; error?: { message: string } } };\n    if (!withPass.passRound) return;\n    workerOrchestrator?.pause();\n    const result = withPass.passRound();\n    setInterveneStatus(result.accepted ? \"Round passed.\" : result.error?.message ?? \"Could not pass.\", result.accepted ? \"ok\" : \"error\");\n    drawGame();\n  });\n  els.tickets?.addEventListener(\"click\", (event) => {\n    const target = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLButtonElement>(\"[data-order-id]\");\n    if (!target || target.hasAttribute(\"data-already-high\")) return;\n    submitIntervention({ kind: \"priority\", targetRole: interveneRole, orderId: target.dataset.orderId!, priority: \"high\" });\n  });\n  els.approve?.addEventListener(\"click\", (event) => {\n    const target = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLButtonElement>(\"[data-decision-id]\");\n    if (!target?.dataset.decisionId || !target.dataset.optionId) return;\n    submitIntervention({\n      kind: \"approve\",\n      targetRole: (target.dataset.speakerRole as PlayerInterventionInput[\"targetRole\"]) ?? interveneRole,\n      decisionId: target.dataset.decisionId,\n      optionId: target.dataset.optionId,\n    });\n  });\n}\n\n/** Refill the ticket list and the approve/deny section from the live view — never the message box, so an in-progress draft survives a tick. */\nfunction refreshInterventionPanel(activeGame: PlayableGame): void {\n  if (activeGame.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return;\n  const els = interveneEls();\n  if (!els.panel) return;\n  const view = arenaView(activeGame);\n\n  const live = (view.orders ?? []).filter((order) => order.status !== \"served\" && order.status !== \"cancelled\");\n  if (els.tickets) {\n    els.tickets.innerHTML = live.length\n      ? live\n          .map((order) => {\n            const label = (order.tableId ?? order.id).replace(\"table-\", \"T\");\n            const alreadyHigh = order.priority === \"high\";\n            return `<button type=\"button\" class=\"arena-intervene-ticket\" data-order-id=\"${order.id}\"${alreadyHigh ? \" data-already-high\" : \"\"}>${label} · ${order.items.join(\"+\") || \"—\"}${alreadyHigh ? \" (high)\" : \"\"}</button>`;\n          })\n          .join(\"\")\n      : `<span class=\"arena-intervene-empty\">No live tickets.</span>`;\n  }\n\n  // The round budget (#262). The engine owns it; the panel only reports it,\n  // so the human manager and the model manager cannot drift apart.\n  const withRounds = activeGame as PlayableGame & { roundStatus?: () => RoundStatus };\n  const round = withRounds.roundStatus?.();\n  if (round && els.budget) {\n    els.budget.textContent = round.canAct\n      ? `Round ${round.round} of ${round.totalRounds} — 1 action left`\n      : `Round ${round.round} of ${round.totalRounds} — spent, the floor runs itself now`;\n    els.budget.dataset.spent = String(!round.canAct);\n  }\n  if (round) {\n    // A spent round closes every write control at once. The keyboard hits the\n    // same budget inside the engine, so there is no shortcut around this.\n    for (const control of [els.send, els.correct, els.pass]) {\n      if (control) control.disabled = !round.canAct;\n    }\n    if (els.text) els.text.disabled = !round.canAct;\n    els.tickets?.querySelectorAll(\"button\").forEach((button) => {\n      (button as HTMLButtonElement).disabled = !round.canAct;\n    });\n  }\n\n  if (els.approve) {\n    const decision = view.decision;\n    if (decision) {\n      els.approve.hidden = false;\n      els.approve.innerHTML =\n        `<p class=\"arena-intervene-label\">${decision.speaker} needs a call — ${decision.title}</p>` +\n        decision.options\n          .map(\n            (option) =>\n              `<button type=\"button\" class=\"arena-intervene-approve-option\" data-tone=\"${option.tone}\" data-decision-id=\"${decision.id}\" data-option-id=\"${option.id}\" data-speaker-role=\"${decision.speakerRole}\">${option.label}</button>`,\n          )\n          .join(\"\");\n    } else {\n      els.approve.hidden = true;\n      els.approve.innerHTML = \"\";\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The header's personal best climbs with the live score, so it has to be\n * refreshed on the in-place path too — `renderGameScreen` only runs on launch.\n */\nfunction setPersonalBest(): void {\n  if (!game || !entry) return;\n  const el = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(\".playing-heading .personal-best\");\n  if (!el) return;\n  const best = personalBest(entry.id, game.score());\n  el.hidden = !best;\n  if (best) setText(el, `Personal best ${best}`);\n}\n\n/**\n * Full repaint — only for entering a game, since it drops every animation.\n * Restaurant Arena draws its own transport controls, HUD and now its own\n * menu/restart on the canvas (see the hotspot() comment in the scene), so it\n * gets no DOM header at all — that chrome would just double up on-canvas\n * controls the player already has.\n */\nfunction renderGameScreen(): void {\n  if (!game || !entry) return;\n  restaurantArenaScene?.destroy();\n  restaurantArenaScene = undefined;\n  const isArena = game.name === \"restaurant-arena\";\n  const best = personalBest(entry.id, game.score());\n  const header = isArena\n    ? \"\"\n    : `<header class=\"playing-heading\"><button type=\"button\" id=\"inline-back\" class=\"inline-back\">‹ Menu</button><div>${playingHeadingTitles(entry, variationCursor)}${replaying ? '<small class=\"mode-title\">Replay</small>' : \"\"}<small class=\"personal-best\"${best ? \"\" : \" hidden\"}>Personal best ${best ?? \"\"}</small></div><button type=\"button\" data-restart aria-label=\"Restart game\">↻ Restart</button></header>`;\n  screenElement.innerHTML = `${header}${renderNativeGame(game)}`;\n  screenElement.dataset.screen = \"game\";\n  screenElement.dataset.game = game.name;\n  const mount = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(\"[data-phaser-mount]\");\n  if (mount && isArena) {\n    const mountScene = () => {\n      if (!mount.isConnected || !game || game.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return;\n      restaurantArenaScene = mountRestaurantArenaScene(\n        mount,\n        arenaView(game),\n        (action) => performAction(action),\n        () => {},\n      );\n      bindInterventionPanel();\n      refreshInterventionPanel(game);\n      setWorkerMode();\n    };\n    // Let the flex/grid layout settle so Phaser boots at the real stage size,\n    // not a half-laid-out box that leaves the floor painted in a corner.\n    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(mountScene));\n  }\n}\n\nfunction drawGame(): void {\n  if (!game || !entry) return;\n  const patch = screenElement.dataset.game === \"restaurant-arena\" ? updateRestaurantArena : undefined;\n  if (!patch?.(game)) {\n    renderGameScreen();\n    return;\n  }\n  setPersonalBest();\n}\n\n\ninterface ArenaDebrief {\n  grade: string;\n  headline: string;\n  met: boolean;\n  targets?: { label: string; value: string; requirement: string; met: boolean }[];\n  lines: { label: string; value: string; good: boolean }[];\n  lessons: string[];\n}\n\n/** The service report: what the shift scored, and what to fix next run. */\nfunction getArenaDebriefHtml(): string {\n  if (!game || game.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return \"\";\n  const view = arenaView(game) as unknown as { debrief?: ArenaDebrief };\n  const debrief = view.debrief;\n  if (!debrief) return \"\";\n  // Whatever the target checks already reported is dropped here: showing\n  // \"Takings $96\" twice, once as a verdict and once as a stat, made the card\n  // longer without making it say more.\n  const checked = new Set((debrief.targets ?? []).map((target) => target.label.toLowerCase()));\n  const lines = debrief.lines\n    .filter((line) => !checked.has(line.label.toLowerCase()))\n    .map(\n      (line) =>\n        `<span class=\"debrief-stat${line.good ? \" is-good\" : \"\"}\"><small>${escapeHtml(line.label)}</small><strong>${escapeHtml(line.value)}</strong></span>`,\n    )\n    .join(\"\");\n  const lessons = debrief.lessons.map((lesson) => `<li>${escapeHtml(lesson)}</li>`).join(\"\");\n  // The verdict names which condition decided it. `lines` below are a\n  // read-at-a-glance summary of the shift on their own thresholds, which are\n  // not tonight's pass bar — keeping the two apart is what stops a green\n  // \"Walkouts 2\" from sitting under a MISSED verdict it actually caused.\n  const targets = (debrief.targets ?? [])\n    .map(\n      (target) =>\n        `<li class=\"debrief-check${target.met ? \" is-met\" : \"\"}\">` +\n        `<span class=\"check-mark\">${target.met ? \"met\" : \"miss\"}</span>` +\n        `<span class=\"check-label\">${escapeHtml(target.label)}</span>` +\n        `<span class=\"check-value\">${escapeHtml(target.value)}</span>` +\n        `<span class=\"check-req\">needs ${escapeHtml(target.requirement)}</span>` +\n        `</li>`,\n    )\n    .join(\"\");\n  return `\n    <div class=\"arena-debrief\"${debrief.met ? The\n      // activity feed still logs the request either way -- it is a log of what\n      // happened, not a description of the current state.\n      if (shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) setWorkerMode(`Pending · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${role}`, \"pending\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${role}: requested live action`);\n      const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();\n      const cancel = () => void invoke(\"cancel_worker_model\", { requestId });\n      signal.addEventListener(\"abort\", cancel, { once: true });\n      try {\n        const response = await invoke<WorkerModelResponse>(\"complete_worker_model\", {\n          requestId,\n          request: { systemPrompt: request.systemPrompt, turnPrompt: request.turnPrompt },\n        });\n        if (signal.aborted) throw new Error(\"model request canceled\");\n        setWorkerStatus(role, \"acting\");\n        addWorkerActivity(`${role}: response received in ${Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt)}ms`);\n        return { text: response.text, metrics: workerModelMetrics(response) };\n      } finally {\n        signal.removeEventListener(\"abort\", cancel);\n      }\n    },\n  });\n  let orchestrator: WorkerOrchestrator;\n  orchestrator = new WorkerOrchestrator(arena, {\n    client,\n    model: workerModel,\n    tickIntervalMs: () => arena.tickMs() || 1_000,\n    onError: (turn) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator) return;\n      setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: fallback — ${turn.error ?? A timer here would start while the request is still in line and\n    // abort a crew that is only waiting its turn.\n    timeoutMs: null,\n    complete: async (request: ModelRequest, signal: AbortSignal) => {\n      const role = request.observation.role;\n      const startedAt = performance.now();\n      setWorkerStatus(role, \"thinking\");\n      // A request already queued behind the account's share is not pending on\n      // the model; the budget banner is the more specific thing to say. The\n      // activity feed still logs the request either way -- it is a log of what\n      // happened, not a description of the current state.\n      if (shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) setWorkerMode(`Pending · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${role}`, \"pending\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${role}: requested live action`);\n      const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();\n      const cancel = () => void invoke(\"cancel_worker_model\", { requestId });\n      signal.addEventListener(\"abort\", cancel, { once: true });\n      try {\n        const response = await invoke<WorkerModelResponse>(\"complete_worker_model\", {\n          requestId,\n          request: { systemPrompt: request.systemPrompt, turnPrompt: request.turnPrompt },\n        });\n        if (signal.aborted) throw new Error(\"model request canceled\");\n        setWorkerStatus(role, \"acting\");\n        addWorkerActivity(`${role}: response received in ${Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt)}ms`);\n        return { text: response.text, metrics: workerModelMetrics(response) };\n      } finally {\n        signal.removeEventListener(\"abort\", cancel);\n      }\n    },\n  });\n  let orchestrator: WorkerOrchestrator;\n  orchestrator = new WorkerOrchestrator(arena, {\n    client,\n    model: workerModel,\n    tickIntervalMs: () => arena.tickMs() || 1_000,\n    onError: (turn) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator) return;\n      setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: fallback — ${turn.error ?? A throttle gets no\n * follow-up report -- the next request simply happens later -- so the\n * countdown is what clears it.\n */\nlet workerBudget: WorkerBudgetState = WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR;\nlet workerBudgetTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;\n\nfunction setWorkerBudget(state: WorkerBudgetState): void {\n  workerBudget = state;\n  if (workerBudgetTimer !== undefined) clearTimeout(workerBudgetTimer);\n  workerBudgetTimer = undefined;\n  const message = workerBudgetMessage(state, workerModelLabel());\n  if (!message) {\n    setWorkerMode();\n    return;\n  }\n  setWorkerMode(message, \"waiting\");\n  workerBudgetTimer = setTimeout(() => setWorkerBudget(WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR), workerBudgetHoldMs(state));\n}\n\nfunction setWorkerMode(message = workerModelLabel(), tone: \"live\" | \"pending\" | \"waiting\" | \"error\" | undefined = workerModel ? \"live\" : undefined): void {\n  const status = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(\"[data-arena-worker-mode]\");\n  if (!status) return;\n  status.textContent = message;\n  if (tone) status.dataset.tone = tone;\n  else delete status.dataset.tone;\n}\n\nfunction setWorkerStatus(role: Role | \"expediter\", status: \"idle\" | \"thinking\" | \"acting\" | \"error\"): void {\n  restaurantArenaScene?.setWorkerStatus(role, status);\n}\n\nfunction addWorkerActivity(message: string): void {\n  workerActivity.unshift(message);\n  workerActivity.splice(8);\n  const feed = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLOListElement>(\"[data-arena-worker-activity]\");\n  if (!feed) return;\n  feed.replaceChildren(...workerActivity.map((entry) => {\n    const item = document.createElement(\"li\");\n    item.textContent = entry;\n    return item;\n  }));\n}\n\nfunction stopWorkerOrchestrator(): void {\n  workerOrchestrator?.stop();\n  workerOrchestrator = undefined;\n  // Leaving the shift ends the wait it described; a banner counting down over\n  // the menu would be describing requests nobody is making.\n  if (workerBudgetTimer !== undefined) clearTimeout(workerBudgetTimer);\n  workerBudgetTimer = undefined;\n  workerBudget = WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR;\n}\n\ninterface WorkerModelResponse {\n  text: string;\n  queueMs: number;\n  providerMs: number;\n  inputTokens?: number;\n  outputTokens?: number;\n  cachedInputTokens?: number;\n  finishReason?: string;\n}\n\n/** Absent provider fields (no usage on this response) stay absent, not zero. */\nfunction workerModelMetrics(response: WorkerModelResponse): ModelCallMetrics {\n  return {\n    queueMs: response.queueMs,\n    providerMs: response.providerMs,\n    ...(response.inputTokens !== undefined ? { inputTokens: response.inputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.outputTokens !== undefined ? { outputTokens: response.outputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.cachedInputTokens !== undefined ? { cachedInputTokens: response.cachedInputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.finishReason !== undefined ? { finishReason: response.finishReason } : {}),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction attachWorkerOrchestrator(activeGame: PlayableGame): void {\n  if (!workerModel || activeGame.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return;\n  workerActivity.length = 0;\n  const arena = activeGame as unknown as RestaurantGame;\n  const client = new WorkerModelClient({\n    retries: 0,\n    // The Rust transport bounds the provider call and starts that bound after\n    // the request budget admits it, so queue time is not charged to the\n    // worker. A timer here would start while the request is still in line and\n    // abort a crew that is only waiting its turn.\n    timeoutMs: null,\n    complete: async (request: ModelRequest, signal: AbortSignal) => {\n      const role = request.observation.role;\n      const startedAt = performance.now();\n      setWorkerStatus(role, \"thinking\");\n      // A request already queued behind the account's share is not pending on\n      // the model; the budget banner is the more specific thing to say. The\n      // activity feed still logs the request either way -- it is a log of what\n      // happened, not a description of the current state.\n      if (shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) setWorkerMode(`Pending · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${role}`, \"pending\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${role}: requested live action`);\n      const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();\n      const cancel = () => void invoke(\"cancel_worker_model\", { requestId });\n      signal.addEventListener(\"abort\", cancel, { once: true });\n      try {\n        const response = await invoke<WorkerModelResponse>(\"complete_worker_model\", {\n          requestId,\n          request: { systemPrompt: request.systemPrompt, turnPrompt: request.turnPrompt },\n        });\n        if (signal.aborted) throw new Error(\"model request canceled\");\n        setWorkerStatus(role, \"acting\");\n        addWorkerActivity(`${role}: response received in ${Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt)}ms`);\n        return { text: response.text, metrics: workerModelMetrics(response) };\n      } finally {\n        signal.removeEventListener(\"abort\", cancel);\n      }\n    },\n  });\n  let orchestrator: WorkerOrchestrator;\n  orchestrator = new WorkerOrchestrator(arena, {\n    client,\n    model: workerModel,\n    tickIntervalMs: () => arena.tickMs() || 1_000,\n    onError: (turn) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator) return;\n      setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: fallback — ${turn.error ?? }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The header's personal best climbs with the live score, so it has to be\n * refreshed on the in-place path too — `renderGameScreen` only runs on launch.\n */\nfunction EXPANDED_SIZE : COMPACT_SIZE;\n}\n\nasync function applySize(size: OverlaySize, minimum: OverlaySize): Promise<void> {\n  try {\n    await windowHandle.setMinSize(overlayLogicalSize(minimum.width, minimum.height));\n    await windowHandle.setSize(overlayLogicalSize(size.width, size.height));\n  } catch {\n    // A window that refuses to resize is not a reason to lose the run.\n  }\n}\n\n/** Reflect the current frame on the titlebar toggle. */\nfunction renderResizeButton(): void {\n  const button = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#resize\");\n  if (!button) return;\n  button.textContent = expanded ? \"↙\" : \"↗\";\n  button.setAttribute(\"aria-label\", expanded ? \"Compact overlay\" : \"Expand overlay\");\n}\n\nfunction applyFrame(): Promise<void> {\n  renderResizeButton();\n  return applySize(frameSize(), MIN_SIZE);\n}\n\nfunction toggleFrame(): void {\n  expanded = !expanded;\n  void applyFrame();\n}\n\n/**\n * Collapse to the handheld pill. event.clientX, y: event.clientY };\n    dragged = false;\n  });\n  pill.addEventListener(\"pointermove\", (event) => {\n    if (!pressedAt || dragged) return;\n    if (Math.abs(event.clientX - document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector)?.focus();\n}\n\nfunction showDialog(dialog: \"paused\" | \"how-to-play\" | \"signout\"): void {\n  pauseState = openDialog(pauseState, dialog);\n syncDialogs();\n}\n\n// ── Session lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunction activeVariationId(): string {\n  return entry?.variations[variationCursor]?.id ?? !game.isOver();\n}\n\nfunction stopTicker(): void {\n  if (tickTimer !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(tickTimer);\n  tickTimer = undefined;\n}\n\n/**\n * Arms the deterministic shift clock. `tickMs()` is the engine's own answer to\n * \"may time pass right now\" — it returns 0 for a shift that has not started,\n * one holding on a decision card, and one that is over.\n */\nfunction scheduleTick(): void {\n  if (tickTimer !== undefined) return;\n  const interval = game?.tickMs?.() ?? 0;\n  if (interval <= 0) return;\n  tickTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {\n    tickTimer = undefined;\n    if (!game || !clockRunning(pauseState, runLive()) || (game.tickMs?.() ?? 0) <= 0) return;\n    // Authored by the environment, not the player: this is the clock.\n    stepGame(\"tick\", \"environment\");\n    actionsTaken++;\n    drawGame();\n  }, interval);\n}\n\n/** Exactly one scheduler runs a shift, and only while nothing is over it. */\nfunction syncClock(): A timer here would start while the request is still in line and\n    // abort a crew that is only waiting its turn.\n    timeoutMs: null,\n    complete: async (request: ModelRequest, signal: AbortSignal) => {\n      const role = request.observation.role;\n      const startedAt = performance.now();\n      setWorkerStatus(role, \"thinking\");\n      // A request already queued behind the account's share is not pending on\n      // the model; the budget banner is the more specific thing to say. The\n      // activity feed still logs the request either way -- it is a log of what\n      // happened, not a description of the current state.\n      if (shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) setWorkerMode(`Pending · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${role}`, \"pending\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${role}: requested live action`);\n      const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();\n      const cancel = () => void invoke(\"cancel_worker_model\", { requestId });\n      signal.addEventListener(\"abort\", cancel, { once: true });\n      try {\n        const response = await invoke<WorkerModelResponse>(\"complete_worker_model\", {\n          requestId,\n          request: { systemPrompt: request.systemPrompt, turnPrompt: request.turnPrompt },\n        });\n        if (signal.aborted) throw new Error(\"model request canceled\");\n        setWorkerStatus(role, \"acting\");\n        addWorkerActivity(`${role}: response received in ${Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt)}ms`);\n        return { text: response.text, metrics: workerModelMetrics(response) };\n      } finally {\n        signal.removeEventListener(\"abort\", cancel);\n      }\n    },\n  });\n  let orchestrator: WorkerOrchestrator;\n  orchestrator = new WorkerOrchestrator(arena, {\n    client,\n    model: workerModel,\n    tickIntervalMs: () => arena.tickMs() || 1_000,\n    onError: (turn) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator) return;\n      setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: fallback — ${turn.error ?? }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The header's personal best climbs with the live score, so it has to be\n * refreshed on the in-place path too — `renderGameScreen` only runs on launch.\n */\nfunction EXPANDED_SIZE : COMPACT_SIZE;\n}\n\nasync function applySize(size: OverlaySize, minimum: OverlaySize): Promise<void> {\n  try {\n    await windowHandle.setMinSize(overlayLogicalSize(minimum.width, minimum.height));\n    await windowHandle.setSize(overlayLogicalSize(size.width, size.height));\n  } catch {\n    // A window that refuses to resize is not a reason to lose the run.\n  }\n}\n\n/** Reflect the current frame on the titlebar toggle. */\nfunction renderResizeButton(): void {\n  const button = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#resize\");\n  if (!button) return;\n  button.textContent = expanded ? \"↙\" : \"↗\";\n  button.setAttribute(\"aria-label\", expanded ? \"Compact overlay\" : \"Expand overlay\");\n}\n\nfunction applyFrame(): Promise<void> {\n  renderResizeButton();\n  return applySize(frameSize(), MIN_SIZE);\n}\n\nfunction toggleFrame(): void {\n  expanded = !expanded;\n  void applyFrame();\n}\n\n/**\n * Collapse to the handheld pill. window never\n  // arrives after it.\n  let pressedAt: { x: number; y: number } | undefined;\n  let dragged = false;\n  pill.addEventListener(\"pointerdown\", (event) => {\n    pressedAt = { x: pressedAt.x) + Math.abs(event.clientY - pressedAt.y) < 4) return;\n    dragged = true;\n    void windowHandle.startDragging().catch(() => undefined);\n  });\n  pill.addEventListener(\"pointerup\", () => { pressedAt = undefined; });\n  pill.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    if (dragged) {\n      dragged = false;\n      return;\n    }\n    restoreFromPill();\n  });\n}\n\n// ── Cards over the pause-state.ts decides which\n// one is up; this only renders that decision and moves focus.\n\nfunction syncDialogs(): void {\n  const cards: [string, PauseState[\"dialog\"]][] = [\n    [\"#return-prompt\", \"paused\"],\n    [\"#how-to-play\", \"how-to-play\"],\n    [\"#signout-prompt\", \"signout\"],\n  ];\n  for (const [selector, dialog] of cards) {\n    const card = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector)?.focus();\n}\n\nfunction showDialog(dialog: \"paused\" | \"how-to-play\" | \"signout\"): void {\n  pauseState = openDialog(pauseState, dialog);\n document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(selector)?.addEventListener(\"click\", handler);\n  // \"Back to coding\" is the minimize gesture: the terminal is usable again and\n  // the run stays held syncDialogs();\n}\n\n// ── Session lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunction activeVariationId(): string {\n  return entry?.variations[variationCursor]?.id ?? \"classic\";\n}\n\n/** A run is on screen and still playable — not a debrief, not the menu. */\nfunction runLive(): boolean {\n  return game !== undefined && !gameEnded && !game.isOver();\n}\n\nfunction stopTicker(): void {\n  if (tickTimer !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(tickTimer);\n  tickTimer = undefined;\n}\n\n/**\n * Arms the deterministic shift clock. `tickMs()` is the engine's own answer to\n * \"may time pass right now\" — it returns 0 for a shift that has not started,\n * one holding on a decision card, and one that is over.\n */\nfunction scheduleTick(): void {\n  if (tickTimer !== undefined) return;\n  const interval = game?.tickMs?.() ?? 0;\n  if (interval <= 0) return;\n  tickTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {\n    tickTimer = undefined;\n    if (!game || !clockRunning(pauseState, runLive()) || (game.tickMs?.() ?? 0) <= 0) return;\n    // Authored by the environment, not the player: this is the clock.\n    stepGame(\"tick\", \"environment\");\n    actionsTaken++;\n    drawGame();\n  }, interval);\n}\n\n/** Exactly one scheduler runs a shift, and only while nothing is over it. */\nfunction syncClock(): void {\n  if (!clockRunning(pauseState, runLive())) {\n    stopTicker();\n    workerOrchestrator?.pause();\n    return;\n  }\n  if (workerOrchestrator) {\n    stopTicker();\n    // start() resumes an already-running loop instead of double-pumping it.\n    workerOrchestrator.start();\n    return;\n  }\n  scheduleTick();\n}\n\n/** Whoever owns the current save: the signed-in account, or \"\" in the actionActor(action: string): TraceActor {\n  return action === \"tick\" || action === \"bot_move\" ? \"environment\" : \"human\";\n}\n\nfunction leaveGameScreen(): void {\n  stopTicker();\n Runs\n * before the debrief is built, which is why the receipt id is kept separately.\n */\nfunction endGame(reason: EpisodeEndReason, completedScore?: number): void {\n  stopTicker();\n  stopWorkerOrchestrator();\n  cancelTraceFlush();\n  const finishedGame = game;\n  const finishedEntry = entry;\n  if (finishedGame && reason !== \"won\" && reason !== \"lost\") {\n    const withAbandon = finishedGame as PlayableGame & { markAbandoned?: (reason: string) => void };\n    withAbandon.markAbandoned?.(reason);\n  }\n  if (activeTrace) {\n    submitTrace(activeTrace, reason, completedScore);\n    activeTrace = undefined;\n  }\n  if (!finishedGame || !finishedEntry) return;\n  const durationMs = Math.max(0, Date.now() - gameStartedAt);\n  const completed = completedScore !== undefined;\n  captureOverlayEvent(\"game.ended\", {\n    game_type: finishedEntry.id,\n    variation_id: activeVariationId(),\n    outcome: completed ?   action === \"tick\" || action === \"bot_move\" ? \"environment\" : \"human\",\n  );\n  actionsTaken++;\n\n  drawGame();\n  return result.moved;\n}\n\nfunction stepGame(action: string, actor: { inputTokens: response.inputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.outputTokens !== undefined ? { outputTokens: response.outputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.cachedInputTokens !== undefined ? { cachedInputTokens: response.cachedInputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.finishReason !== undefined ? { finishReason: response.finishReason } : {}),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction attachWorkerOrchestrator(activeGame: PlayableGame): void {\n  if (!workerModel || activeGame.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return;\n  workerActivity.length = 0;\n  const arena = activeGame as unknown as RestaurantGame;\n  const client = new WorkerModelClient({\n    retries: 0,\n    // The Rust transport bounds the provider call and starts that bound after\n    // the request budget admits it, so queue time is not charged to the\n    // worker. A timer here would start while the request is still in line and\n    // abort a crew that is only waiting its turn.\n    timeoutMs: null,\n    complete: async (request: ModelRequest, signal: AbortSignal) => {\n      const role = request.observation.role;\n      const startedAt = performance.now();\n      setWorkerStatus(role, \"thinking\");\n      // A request already queued behind the account's share is not pending on\n      // the model; the budget banner is the more specific thing to say. The\n      // activity feed still logs the request either way -- it is a log of what\n      // happened, not a description of the current state.\n      if (shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) setWorkerMode(`Pending · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${role}`, \"pending\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${role}: requested live action`);\n      const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();\n      const cancel = () => void invoke(\"cancel_worker_model\", { requestId });\n      signal.addEventListener(\"abort\", cancel, { once: true });\n      try {\n        const response = await invoke<WorkerModelResponse>(\"complete_worker_model\", {\n          requestId,\n          request: { systemPrompt: request.systemPrompt, turnPrompt: request.turnPrompt },\n        });\n        if (signal.aborted) throw new Error(\"model request canceled\");\n        setWorkerStatus(role, \"acting\");\n        addWorkerActivity(`${role}: response received in ${Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt)}ms`);\n        return { text: response.text, metrics: workerModelMetrics(response) };\n      } finally {\n        signal.removeEventListener(\"abort\", cancel);\n      }\n    },\n  });\n  let orchestrator: WorkerOrchestrator;\n  orchestrator = new WorkerOrchestrator(arena, {\n    client,\n    model: workerModel,\n    tickIntervalMs: () => arena.tickMs() || 1_000,\n    onError: (turn) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator) return;\n      setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: fallback — ${turn.error ?? }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The header's personal best climbs with the live score, so it has to be\n * refreshed on the in-place path too — `renderGameScreen` only runs on launch.\n */\nfunction document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector)?.focus();\n}\n\nfunction showDialog(dialog: \"paused\" | \"how-to-play\" | \"signout\"): void {\n  pauseState = openDialog(pauseState, dialog);\n syncDialogs();\n}\n\n// ── Session lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunction activeVariationId(): string {\n  return entry?.variations[variationCursor]?.id ?? !game.isOver();\n}\n\nfunction stopTicker(): void {\n  if (tickTimer !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(tickTimer);\n  tickTimer = undefined;\n}\n\n/**\n * Arms the deterministic shift clock. scheduleTick(): void {\n  if (tickTimer !== undefined) return;\n  const interval = game?.tickMs?.() ?? 0;\n  if (interval <= 0) return;\n  tickTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {\n    tickTimer = stepGame(\"tick\", \"environment\");\n    actionsTaken++;\n    drawGame();\n  }, interval);\n}\n\n/** Exactly one scheduler runs a shift, and only while nothing is over it. */\nfunction syncClock(): void {\n  if (!clockRunning(pauseState, runLive())) {\n    stopTicker();\n    workerOrchestrator?.pause();\n    return;\n  }\n  if (workerOrchestrator) {\n    stopTicker();\n    // start() resumes an already-running loop instead of double-pumping it.\n    workerOrchestrator.start();\n    return;\n  }\n  scheduleTick();\n}\n\n/** Whoever owns the current save: the signed-in account, or \"\" in the browser. */\nfunction saveOwnerId(): string {\n  return signedInUser()?.id ?? \"\";\n}\n\n// The resume record grows by one entry per accepted action, and a busy shift\n// accepts several a second, so the JSON is written on a slow timer instead of\n// on every step. Losing the last couple of seconds of a run to a hard kill\n// costs the player nothing they will notice; re-serializing a long action log\n// at tick rate would.\nconst SAVE_INTERVAL_MS = 2_000;\nlet saveTimer: number | undefined;\nlet savePending = false;\n\nfunction flushSavedGame(): void {\n  if (saveTimer !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(saveTimer);\n  saveTimer = undefined;\n  if (savePending && savedGame) writeSavedGame(savedGame);\n  savePending = false;\n}\n\nfunction scheduleSavedGameWrite(): void {\n  savePending = true;\n  if (saveTimer === undefined) saveTimer = window.setTimeout(flushSavedGame, SAVE_INTERVAL_MS);\n}\n\n/** Forget the run in progress entirely: nothing to resume, nothing to write. */\nfunction dropSavedGame(): void {\n  savePending = false;\n  if (saveTimer !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(saveTimer);\n  saveTimer = undefined;\n  savedGame = undefined;\n  clearSavedGame();\n}\n\n/** Record one accepted action on the resume record. */\nfunction recordSavedAction(action: string): void {\n  const saved = savedGame;\n  if (!saved) return;\n  if (!appendSavedAction(saved, action)) {\n    // Past the log's ceiling the record no longer describes the run, and\n    // replaying a truncated log would rebuild the wrong shift — so it is\n    // dropped rather than offered back as a resume.\n    dropSavedGame();\n    return;\n  }\n  scheduleSavedGameWrite();\n}\n\n/** The same split `performAction` records, so a replay reproduces its authors. */\nfunction actionActor(action: string): TraceActor {\n  return action === \"tick\" || action === \"bot_move\" ? \"environment\" : \"human\";\n}\n\nfunction leaveGameScreen(): void {\n  stopTicker();\n  stopWorkerOrchestrator();\n  cancelTraceFlush();\n  restaurantArenaScene?.destroy();\n  restaurantArenaScene = undefined;\n  game = undefined;\n  gameEnded = false;\n  replaying = false;\n}\n\n/**\n * Opens a run: a fresh one, or a stored one rebuilt action-by-action.\n *\n * The save is written here rather than at the first action, so a launch that\n * crashes before the player touches anything still resumes the same seed.\n */\nfunction startRun(selected: GameEntry, variationId: string, restored?: { game: PlayableGame; actions: string[]; seed: number }): void {\n  if (!selected.create) return;\n  leaveGameScreen();\n  entry = selected;\n  cursor = Math.max(0, MENU_GAMES.findIndex(({ id }) => id === selected.id));\n  variationCursor = Math.max(0, selected.variations.findIndex(({ id }) => id === variationId));\n  const resolvedVariation = selected.variations[variationCursor]?.id ?? variationId;\n\n  const seed = restored?.seed ?? randomSeed();\n  game = restored?.game ?? selected.create(resolvedVariation);\n  if (!restored) game.reset(seed);\n\n  const replayedActions = restored?.actions ?? [];\n  gameStartedAt = Date.now();\n  actionsTaken = replayedActions.length;\n  gameEnded = false;\n\n  activeTrace = createOverlayTrace(selected, resolvedVariation, seed);\n  for (const action of replayedActions) appendOverlayAction(activeTrace, action, actionActor(action));\n  persistTrace(activeTrace);\n  // One id names the run everywhere it can be matched back: the trace export,\n  // the queued chunks, the completed-game result, the analytics subject, and\n  // the receipt printed on the debrief (#281).\n  gameSessionId = activeTrace.gameId;\n  sessionReceiptId = activeTrace.gameId;\n\n  savedGame = startSavedGame(selected, resolvedVariation, seed, saveOwnerId());\n  // Only the actions the engine still accepts survive a rebuild, so the save is\n  // rewritten from what actually replayed rather than from what was stored.\n  for (const action of replayedActions) appendSavedAction(savedGame, action);\n  writeSavedGame(savedGame);\n\n  screen = \"game\";\n  pauseState = { ...resumePlay(pauseState), dialog: \"none\" };\n  syncDialogs();\n  attachWorkerOrchestrator(game);\n  renderGameScreen();\n  captureOverlayEvent(\n    \"game.started\",\n    { game_type: selected.id, variation_id: resolvedVariation },\n    gameSessionId,\n  );\n  syncClock();\n}\n\n/** Rebuild the stored run, or drop a save this build can no longer replay. */\nfunction resumeSavedGame(): void {\n  const saved = savedGame;\n  const found = saved ? MENU_GAMES.find(({ id }) => id === saved.gameId) : undefined;\n  const restored = saved && found ? restoreGame(found, saved) : null;\n  if (!saved || !found || !restored) {\n    clearSavedGame();\n    savedGame = undefined;\n    screen = \"menu\";\n    drawMenu();\n    return;\n  }\n  startRun(found, saved.variationId, { ...restored, seed: saved.seed });\n}\n\n/**\n * Hands the run's trace to the recording store and logs the outcome. Runs\n * before the debrief is built, which is why the receipt id is kept separately.\n */\nfunction endGame(reason: EpisodeEndReason, completedScore?: number): void {\n  stopTicker();\n  stopWorkerOrchestrator();\n  cancelTraceFlush();\n  const finishedGame = game;\n  const finishedEntry = entry;\n  if (finishedGame && reason !== \"won\" && reason !== \"lost\") {\n    const withAbandon = finishedGame as PlayableGame & { markAbandoned?: (reason: string) => void };\n    withAbandon.markAbandoned?.(reason);\n  }\n  if (activeTrace) {\n    submitTrace(activeTrace, reason, completedScore);\n    activeTrace = undefined;\n  }\n  if (!finishedGame || !finishedEntry) return;\n  const durationMs = Math.max(0, Date.now() - gameStartedAt);\n  const completed = completedScore !== undefined;\n  captureOverlayEvent(\"game.ended\", {\n    game_type: finishedEntry.id,\n    variation_id: activeVariationId(),\n    outcome: completed ? \"completed\" : \"abandoned\",\n    score: finishedGame.score(),\n    success: finishedGame.hasWon(),\n    duration_ms: durationMs,\n    actions_taken: actionsTaken,\n  }, gameSessionId);\n  if (!completed || !gameSessionId) return;\n  void invoke(\"append_local_score\", {\n    score: {\n      game_id: gameSessionId,\n      game_type: finishedEntry.id,\n      variation_id: activeVariationId(),\n      // The local log holds completed-run scores, which cannot be negative; a\n      // shift that burned more than it took home lands at zero rather than\n      // being rejected and lost.\n      score: Math.max(0, Math.round(completedScore)),\n      success: finishedGame.hasWon(),\n      completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n      duration_ms: durationMs,\n      platform: \"overlay\",\n    },\n  }).then(() => refreshLocalScores()).catch(() => undefined);\n}\n\n/** The shift ran to the end of the night: score it and show the debrief. */\nfunction finishRun(): void {\n  if (!game || gameEnded) return;\n  gameEnded = true;\n  const score = game.score();\n  const won = game.hasWon();\n  // Nothing left to resume, and the debrief is the last word on this run.\n  clearSavedGame();\n  savedGame = undefined;\n  endGame(won ? \"won\" : \"lost\", score);\n  renderEndCard();\n}\n\n/**\n * Ending a shift mid-run: back to the menu with the save untouched, so the\n * same seed and action log can be resumed on a later launch (README §Session\n * save). The window is deliberately not touched — a host `gamepigeon:reset`\n * snaps a hidden overlay back to the menu without popping it open.\n */\nfunction endShift(reason: EpisodeEndReason = \"user_quit\"): void {\n  if (game && !gameEnded) endGame(reason);\n  leaveGameScreen();\n  pauseState = { ...resumePlay(pauseState), dialog: \"none\" };\n  syncDialogs();\n  screen = \"menu\";\n  cursor = -1;\n  drawMenu();\n}\n\n/**\n * Restart mid-run: a brand-new run of the same game and variation. ` · ${workerModel.version}` : \"\"}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * What the shared model account is doing to this shift, and the timer that\n * takes the banner down if the transport goes quiet. \"live\" : undefined): void {\n  const status = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(\"[data-arena-worker-mode]\");\n  if (!status) return;\n  status.textContent = message;\n  if (tone) status.dataset.tone = tone;\n  else delete status.dataset.tone;\n}\n\nfunction setWorkerStatus(role: Role | \"expediter\", status: \"idle\" | \"thinking\" | \"acting\" | \"error\"): void {\n  restaurantArenaScene?.setWorkerStatus(role, status);\n}\n\nfunction addWorkerActivity(message: string): void {\n  workerActivity.unshift(message);\n  workerActivity.splice(8);\n  const feed = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLOListElement>(\"[data-arena-worker-activity]\");\n  if (!feed) return;\n  feed.replaceChildren(...workerActivity.map((entry) => {\n    const item = document.createElement(\"li\");\n    item.textContent = entry;\n    return item;\n  }));\n}\n\nfunction stopWorkerOrchestrator(): void {\n  workerOrchestrator?.stop();\n  workerOrchestrator = undefined;\n  // Leaving the shift ends the wait it described; a banner counting down over\n  // the menu would be describing requests nobody is making.\n  if (workerBudgetTimer !== undefined) clearTimeout(workerBudgetTimer);\n  workerBudgetTimer = undefined;\n  workerBudget = WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR;\n}\n\ninterface WorkerModelResponse {\n  text: string;\n  queueMs: number;\n  providerMs: number;\n  inputTokens?: number;\n  outputTokens?: number;\n  cachedInputTokens?: number;\n  finishReason?: string;\n}\n\n/** Absent provider fields (no usage on this response) stay absent, not zero. */\nfunction workerModelMetrics(response: WorkerModelResponse): ModelCallMetrics {\n  return {\n    queueMs: response.queueMs,\n    providerMs: response.providerMs,\n    ...(response.inputTokens !== undefined ? { inputTokens: response.inputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.outputTokens !== undefined ? { outputTokens: response.outputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.cachedInputTokens !== undefined ? { cachedInputTokens: response.cachedInputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.finishReason !== undefined ? { finishReason: response.finishReason } : {}),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction attachWorkerOrchestrator(activeGame: PlayableGame): void {\n  if (!workerModel || activeGame.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return;\n  workerActivity.length = 0;\n  const arena = activeGame as unknown as RestaurantGame;\n  const client = new WorkerModelClient({\n    retries: 0,\n    // The Rust transport bounds the provider call and starts that bound after\n    // the request budget admits it, so queue time is not charged to the\n    // worker. A timer here would start while the request is still in line and\n    // abort a crew that is only waiting its turn.\n    timeoutMs: null,\n    complete: async (request: ModelRequest, signal: AbortSignal) => {\n      const role = request.observation.role;\n      const startedAt = performance.now();\n      setWorkerStatus(role, \"thinking\");\n      // A request already queued behind the account's share is not pending on\n      // the model; the budget banner is the more specific thing to say. The\n      // activity feed still logs the request either way -- it is a log of what\n      // happened, not a description of the current state.\n      if (shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) setWorkerMode(`Pending · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${role}`, \"pending\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${role}: requested live action`);\n      const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();\n      const cancel = () => void invoke(\"cancel_worker_model\", { requestId });\n      signal.addEventListener(\"abort\", cancel, { once: true });\n      try {\n        const response = await invoke<WorkerModelResponse>(\"complete_worker_model\", {\n          requestId,\n          request: { systemPrompt: request.systemPrompt, turnPrompt: request.turnPrompt },\n        });\n        if (signal.aborted) throw new Error(\"model request canceled\");\n        setWorkerStatus(role, \"acting\");\n        addWorkerActivity(`${role}: response received in ${Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt)}ms`);\n        return { text: response.text, metrics: workerModelMetrics(response) };\n      } finally {\n        signal.removeEventListener(\"abort\", cancel);\n      }\n    },\n  });\n  let orchestrator: WorkerOrchestrator;\n  orchestrator = new WorkerOrchestrator(arena, {\n    client,\n    model: workerModel,\n    tickIntervalMs: () => arena.tickMs() || 1_000,\n    onError: (turn) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator) return;\n      setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: fallback — ${turn.error ?? Doing\n  // nothing and choosing to do nothing read identically in a trace otherwise.\n  els.pass?.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    if (!game) return;\n    const withPass = game as PlayableGame & { passRound?: () => { accepted: boolean; error?: { message: string } } };\n    if (!withPass.passRound) return;\n    workerOrchestrator?.pause();\n    const result = withPass.passRound();\n    setInterveneStatus(result.accepted ? \"Round passed.\" : result.error?.message ?? \"Could not pass.\", result.accepted ? \"ok\" : \"error\");\n    drawGame();\n  });\n  els.tickets?.addEventListener(\"click\", (event) => {\n    const target = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLButtonElement>(\"[data-order-id]\");\n    if (!target || target.hasAttribute(\"data-already-high\")) return;\n    submitIntervention({ kind: \"priority\", targetRole: interveneRole, orderId: target.dataset.orderId!, priority: \"high\" });\n  });\n  els.approve?.addEventListener(\"click\", (event) => {\n    const target = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLButtonElement>(\"[data-decision-id]\");\n    if (!target?.dataset.decisionId || !target.dataset.optionId) return;\n    submitIntervention({\n      kind: \"approve\",\n      targetRole: (target.dataset.speakerRole as PlayerInterventionInput[\"targetRole\"]) ?? interveneRole,\n      decisionId: target.dataset.decisionId,\n      optionId: target.dataset.optionId,\n    });\n  });\n}\n\n/** Refill the ticket list and the approve/deny section from the live view — never the message box, so an in-progress draft survives a tick. */\nfunction refreshInterventionPanel(activeGame: PlayableGame): void {\n  if (activeGame.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return;\n  const els = interveneEls();\n  if (!els.panel) return;\n  const view = arenaView(activeGame);\n\n  const live = (view.orders ?? class=\"arena-intervene-label\">${decision.speaker} needs a call — ${decision.title}</p>` +\n        decision.options\n          .map(\n            (option) =>\n              `<button type=\"button\" }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The header's personal best climbs with the live score, so it has to be\n * refreshed on the in-place path too — `renderGameScreen` only runs on launch.\n */\nfunction setPersonalBest(): void {\n  if (!game || !entry) return;\n  const el = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(\".playing-heading .personal-best\");\n  if (!el) return;\n  const best = personalBest(entry.id, game.score());\n  el.hidden = !best;\n  if (best) setText(el, `Personal best ${best}`);\n}\n\n/**\n * Full repaint — only for entering a game, since it drops every animation.\n restaurantArenaScene = undefined;\n  const isArena = game.name === \"restaurant-arena\";\n  const best = personalBest(entry.id, game.score());\n  const header = isArena\n    ? \"\"\n    : `<header Order matters in both directions:\n// the minimum is set before the size, because the pill is smaller than the\n// restored floor and a stale minimum would silently clamp it.\n\nfunction frameSize(): OverlaySize {\n  return expanded ? EXPANDED_SIZE : COMPACT_SIZE;\n}\n\nasync function applySize(size: OverlaySize, minimum: OverlaySize): Promise<void> {\n  try {\n    await windowHandle.setMinSize(overlayLogicalSize(minimum.width, minimum.height));\n    await windowHandle.setSize(overlayLogicalSize(size.width, size.height));\n  } catch {\n    // A window that refuses to resize is not a reason to lose the run.\n  }\n}\n\n/** Reflect the current frame on the titlebar toggle. */\nfunction renderResizeButton(): void {\n  const button = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#resize\");\n  if (!button) return;\n  button.textContent = expanded ? \"↙\" : \"↗\";\n  button.setAttribute(\"aria-label\", expanded ? \"Compact overlay\" : \"Expand overlay\");\n}\n\nfunction applyFrame(): Promise<void> {\n  renderResizeButton();\n  return applySize(frameSize(), MIN_SIZE);\n}\n\nfunction toggleFrame(): void {\n  expanded = !expanded;\n  void applyFrame();\n}\n\n/**\n * Collapse to the handheld pill. The run is left exactly as it is — held by\n * `clockRunning`, not ended — because this is the \"back to coding\" gesture and\n * the player expects to find their shift where they left it.\n */\nfunction minimizeToPill(): void {\n  if (pauseState.minimized) return;\n  pauseState = minimize(pauseState);\n  document.body.dataset.mode = \"pill\";\n  syncDialogs();\n  syncClock();\n  void applySize(PILL_SIZE, PILL_SIZE).then(() => {\n    document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#pill\")?.focus();\n  });\n}\n\nfunction restoreFromPill(): void {\n  if (!pauseState.minimized) return;\n  pauseState = restore(pauseState);\n  delete document.body.dataset.mode;\n  syncDialogs();\n  syncClock();\n  void applyFrame().then(() => windowHandle.center()).catch(() => undefined);\n}\n\nfunction bindWindowChrome(): void {\n  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#resize\")?.addEventListener(\"click\", toggleFrame);\n  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#hide\")?.addEventListener(\"click\", minimizeToPill);\n  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#shutdown\")?.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    // Rust writes the session's shutdown flag and exits, so the launcher stops\n    // re-opening the overlay until the next session. A no-op in the browser.\n    void invoke(\"shutdown\").catch(() => undefined);\n  });\n\n  const pill = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#pill\");\n  if (!pill) return;\n  // The pill is both the drag handle and the reopen button, so dragging is\n  // armed on movement rather than on press: `startDragging` hands the pointer\n  // to the compositor, and the click that would reopen the window never\n  // arrives after it.\n  let pressedAt: { x: number; y: number } | undefined;\n  let dragged = false;\n  pill.addEventListener(\"pointerdown\", (event) => {\n    pressedAt = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };\n    dragged = false;\n  });\n  pill.addEventListener(\"pointermove\", (event) => {\n    if (!pressedAt || dragged) return;\n    if (Math.abs(event.clientX - pressedAt.x) + Math.abs(event.clientY - pressedAt.y) < 4) return;\n    dragged = true;\n    void windowHandle.startDragging().catch(() => undefined);\n  });\n  pill.addEventListener(\"pointerup\", () => { pressedAt = undefined; });\n  pill.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    if (dragged) {\n      dragged = false;\n      return;\n    }\n    restoreFromPill();\n  });\n}\n\n// ── Cards over the pause-state.ts decides which\n// one is up; this only renders that decision and moves focus.\n\nfunction syncDialogs(): void {\n  const cards: [string, PauseState[\"dialog\"]][] = [\n    [\"#return-prompt\", \"paused\"],\n    [\"#how-to-play\", \"how-to-play\"],\n    [\"#signout-prompt\", \"signout\"],\n  ];\n  for (const [selector, dialog] of cards) {\n    const card = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector);\n    if (card) card.hidden = pauseState.dialog !== dialog;\n  }\n}\n\nfunction focusDialog(selector: string): void {\n  document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector)?.focus();\n}\n\nfunction showDialog(dialog: \"paused\" | \"how-to-play\" | \"signout\"): void {\n  pauseState = openDialog(pauseState, dialog);\n === \"how-to-play\") focusDialog(\"#how-to-play-close\");\n  else if (dialog === \"signout\") focusDialog(\"#signout-confirm\");\n  else focusDialog(\"#return-code\");\n}\n\nfunction closeTopDialog(): pauseState = resumePlay(pauseState);\n  syncDialogs();\n  syncClock();\n}\n\nfunction confirmSignOut(): void {\n  void signOut().then(() => {\n    // Leaving the shift keeps its save exactly as it is; drawGate();\n  }).catch(() => {\n    // signOut() throws with credentials still on disk, so the session is\n    // genuinely still open — say nothing and leave the confirmation up.\n    focusDialog(\"#signout-cancel\");\n  });\n}\n\nfunction bindDialogs(): void {\n  const on = (selector: string, handler: () => void) =>\n    document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(selector)?.addEventListener(\"click\", handler);\n  // \"Back to coding\" is the minimize gesture: the terminal is usable again and\n  // the run stays held syncDialogs();\n}\n\n// ── Session lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunction activeVariationId(): string {\n  return entry?.variations[variationCursor]?.id ??
